pairs.target: liǎngzhōu de biǎo cóng qiángshàng qǔ xiàlái shí , zhǐ jiǎo liúxià sìkuài qiǎnsè , xiàng qiáng yě bèi tā zhēdé shǎo shài le xiē rìtou .
pairs.english: Removing the two-week chart left four pale patches on the wall, as if it too had seen less sunlight.
pairs.hanzi: 两周的表从墙上取下来时，纸角留下四块浅色，像墙也被它遮得少晒了些日头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài tī páng jiē zhǐ , bèihòu yǒurén wèn yuán biǎo shìbushì zài yòng bùdé , dǒng lǐshì shuō yòng dé , xiān chāo wán zài tiē , biéjí zhe nálái bāo dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi took it beside the ladder. Someone behind asked if the old sheet was unusable; Director Dong said it was fine: copy it before reposting, don't rush to wrap things in it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在梯旁接纸，背后有人问原表是不是再用不得，董理事说用得，先抄完再贴，别急着拿来包东西。

pairs.target: zì yìdìng yōuxiān bāncì , yǐjīng guò le shíwǔrì .
pairs.english: Fifteen days had passed since the priority slots were agreed.
pairs.hanzi: 自议定优先班次，已经过了十五日。

pairs.target: cūn liáng dào cāng de huídān duō le , gōngwū de méi bǔ le dàbàn , háiyǒu yíchù gāo cūn quē de nà pī , chē zài běipō wài de zhuǎn huò chù děng , bùnéng jiǎzhuāng míngdān shàng xiě wán jiùsuàn sòngdào .
pairs.english: More grain warehouse receipts had come back, communal coal was mostly replenished, but a high village's remaining grain still waited at a transfer point beyond the northern slope. Being listed wasn't delivery.
pairs.hanzi: 村粮到仓的回单多了，公屋的煤补了大半，还有一处高村缺的那批，车在北坡外的转货处等，不能假装名单上写完就算送到。

pairs.target: xiānhuò wùdiǎn nà jǐxiàng yě méi xiāoshī , chǎngnèi duō děng de nàduàn yóu chēduì yǔ huòchǎng lìngjì , lùshang de mànxíng lìng liè , huòzhǔ yǐ jiāng huàidiào de shù bǔ shàng , péibǔ zěnme fēn réng dài gèzì guǎnshì qiān huí .
pairs.english: Produce delays remained too: extra yard waiting and road slowdowns were listed separately; the owner had supplied spoilage quantities, but division of compensation awaited managers' signatures.
pairs.hanzi: 鲜货误点那几项也没消失，场内多等的那段由车队与货场另记，路上的慢行另列，货主已将坏掉的数补上，赔补怎么分仍待各自管事签回。

pairs.target: jīnrì zuò de rén méi shàng huí duō , dàilái de zhǐ què hòu .
pairs.english: Fewer attended today than last time, but brought thicker papers.
pairs.hanzi: 今日坐的人没上回多，带来的纸却厚。

pairs.target: dǒnglǐ shìxiān niàn shíjì dàohuò de shù , zài wèn shèngxià nà pī cūn liáng xūyào jǐbān .
pairs.english: Director Dong read actual arrivals first and asked how many slots the remaining grain needed.
pairs.hanzi: 董理事先念实际到货的数，再问剩下那批村粮需要几班。

pairs.target: liángshāng yào xù yuánlái de liǎngbān , shuō kōng zhe zǒngnéng bǔ biéde huò , hòupái yǒurén lìkè wèn , wèishénme biérén de chē yào děngdào lín kāi cái zhīdào yǒuméiyǒu wèizhì .
pairs.english: The merchant wanted both original slots continued, saying spare places could take other cargo. Someone at the back immediately asked why others' carts must wait until departure to know whether a place existed.
pairs.hanzi: 粮商要续原来的两班，说空着总能补别的货，后排有人立刻问，为什么别人的车要等到临开才知道有没有位置。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méi tì zhè jù huà shōuwěi , zhī bǎ guòqù liǎngzhōu kōngxiàlái de nà jǐgè wèizhì diǎn chūlái .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng didn't finish that argument for them, only pointing out the past fortnight's unused spaces.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没替这句话收尾，只把过去两周空下来的那几个位置点出来。

pairs.target: yǒu liǎngcì bǔ dé shàng , yǒu yícì rén yǐ huàn lù zǒu , kòngwèi biàn zhēnde kōng zhe .
pairs.english: Of the three spaces, two were filled, one stayed empty because people had changed routes.
pairs.hanzi: 有两次补得上，有一次人已换路走，空位便真的空着。

pairs.target: tā jiāng lìng yìzhāng zhuǎn huò chù de huíbào fàng pángbiān , ràng liángshāng zìjǐ kàn shèngxià de xiāng shù , bù ná fēng zhàn zhè tóu xièdé kuài dàngchéng nà tóu bìrán yě néng kuài .
pairs.english: He set a transfer-point report beside them for the merchant to see the remaining crate count: fast unloading at Wind Trestle didn't guarantee it could match that speed there too.
pairs.hanzi: 他将另一张转货处的回报放旁边，让粮商自己看剩下的箱数，不拿风栈这头卸得快当成那头必然也能快。

pairs.target: yì dào mòliǎo , liúxià de shì yìzhōu , yígè zǎobān , zhuān gěi shàngwèi bǔzú de nà pī cūn liáng tóng gōngwū yúxià de méi ; sījiā cúnhuò zhàojiù lìng pái .
pairs.english: The result was one week and one morning slot for the still-missing village grain and communal coal; private stocks stayed separate.
pairs.hanzi: 议到末了，留下的是一周、一个早班，专给尚未补足的那批村粮同公屋余下的煤；私家存货照旧另排。

pairs.target: qián yírì biàn tiē qīng yúwèi , búzài tuō dào lín kāi cái shuō , xiānhuò wǔqián xiè wèi bǎoliú .
pairs.english: Spare capacity must be posted the day before, not at departure, and the late-morning produce bay retained.
pairs.hanzi: 前一日便贴清余位，不再拖到临开才说，鲜货午前卸位保留。

pairs.target: duìàn yǔ zhuǎn huò chù gè quèrèn zìjǐ de bùfen , zài guò yìzhōu kàn shídào shù , bù xiān dāying yì zhěnggè dōngtiān .
pairs.english: The far bank and transfer point must each confirm their portions, with actual arrivals reviewed in a week rather than promising a whole winter now.
pairs.hanzi: 对岸与转货处各确认自己的部分，再过一周看实到数，不先答应一整个冬天。

pairs.target: yǒurén shuō gǎi dé tàixì , dǒng lǐshì biàn jiāng jiù yuè biǎo ná chūlái , wèn shìbushì hái xiǎng zhào yuánlái yícì xiě sìzhōu .
pairs.english: Someone complained the revision was too detailed. Director Dong brought out the old monthly chart: did he want to write four weeks at once again?
pairs.hanzi: 有人说改得太细，董理事便将旧月表拿出来，问是不是还想照原来一次写四周。

pairs.target: nà rén kàn le kàn , méi diǎntóu , yě méi shuō tā duì , shōuqǐ zìjǐ de dānzi chūqù .
pairs.english: He neither nodded nor agreed she was right, leaving with his orders.
pairs.hanzi: 那人看了看，没点头，也没说她对，收起自己的单子出去。

pairs.target: sànhuì hòu , tǎ wéi tìrén fútī , jiāng nà zhāng duō zhé guò jǐhuí de biǎo chóngxīn tiē shàng , jiù jiāo hén méi néng wánquán gàizhù .
pairs.english: Afterwards Tavi steadied the ladder and reposted the creased chart; the old glue marks weren't completely covered.
pairs.hanzi: 散会后，塔维替人扶梯，将那张多折过几回的表重新贴上，旧胶痕没能完全盖住。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shōushí zhǐ shí , gěi tā kàn xuégōng sònghuí de fùhé ānpái .
pairs.english: Sorting papers, Ruan Heng showed him the academy's review appointment.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡收拾纸时，给他看学宫送回的复核安排。

pairs.target: xìn lǐ rìqī yǐjīng dìngxià , shí zuò qīmò hòu sānrì dào wéi lǎoshī nàlǐ , gōngjù réng zài xuégōng , lǎoshī huì xiān hé bǎoguǎn jìlù , zài yóu tā zuò wánzhěng de zhǔnbèi yǔ dúshù .
pairs.english: The date was fixed: Teacher Vey, three days after the placement's end. His tools remained at the academy; she would check storage records before his full preparation and readings.
pairs.hanzi: 信里日期已经定下，实作期末后三日到维老师那里，工具仍在学宫，老师会先核保管记录，再由他做完整的准备与读数。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng yě yào qù , búshì ràng tā dúzì ná zhe yítà zhǐ tì zìjǐ shuō qīng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng would attend too, not leave him alone with papers to explain himself.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡也要去，不是让他独自拿着一沓纸替自己说清。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài xīnlǐ shù le rìzi .
pairs.english: Tavi counted the days inwardly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在心里数了日子。

pairs.target: lí shíliù zhōu de zuìhòu yìbān hái shèng bārì ; jiēzhe zuò cìrì de gōnggòng chē huíqù , zhōngtú zhù yíyè , jìnchéng hòu de cìrì , biàn yào fùhé .
pairs.english: Eight days remained until the last shift of sixteen weeks; then the following day's public cart, an overnight stop, arrival in the city and the review the next day.
pairs.hanzi: 离十六周的最后一班还剩八日；接着坐次日的公共车回去，中途住一夜，进城后的次日，便要复核。

pairs.target: shùzì xiě zài zhǐ shàng bùyuǎn , zhēn yào jiāng chuángdǐ , zhuō jiǎo hé huòchǎng shàng de huó yíchùchù shōuqí , què bǐ tā xiǎng de duō . "
pairs.english: The numbers looked near on paper; collecting work from his bedside, desk and freight yard was more than he'd expected.
pairs.hanzi:
数字写在纸上不远，真要将床底、桌角和货场上的活一处处收齐，却比他想的多。
“

pairs.target: wǒ zǒu le , zhè biǎo hái dé gǎi . "
pairs.english: “After I leave, this chart will still need changes,”
pairs.hanzi: 我走了，这表还得改。”

pairs.target: tā shuō .
pairs.english: He said.
pairs.hanzi: 他说。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng táitóu , xiàngshì bù dǒng tā wèihé hūrán shuō zhè jù , jiēzhe shuō dāngrán , dōngtiān yòu bù gēn tā yìqǐ huí xuégōng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng looked up as though puzzled by this, then said of course: winter wasn't returning to the academy with him.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡抬头，像是不懂他为何忽然说这句，接着说当然，冬天又不跟他一起回学宫。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǒudiǎn jiǒng , zìjǐ yě xiào .
pairs.english: Embarrassed, Tavi laughed too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维有点窘，自己也笑。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng huíchéng de chēcì quān chūlái , wèn tā xiǎng buxiǎng kàochuāng , ruò yùnchē biàn bié yìngqiǎng nàbiān hǎokàn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng circled the return departure, asking whether he wanted a window seat: don't insist on the view if he got carsick.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将回程的车次圈出来，问他想不想靠窗，若晕车便别硬抢那边好看。

pairs.target: chūménshí , tǎ wéi jiàn nà zhāng xīn biǎo xià yǐjīng zhàn le liǎnggè rén .
pairs.english: Outside, Tavi saw two people already standing below the new chart.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，塔维见那张新表下已经站了两个人。

pairs.target: yì rén niàn , yì rén shēnshǒu shù , liǎng rén duì tóngyígè zì háiyǒu bùtóng yìsī , zhèngyào jìnqù zhǎo rén .
pairs.english: One read, one counted with a finger. The two differed about one word's meaning and were coming in to ask.
pairs.hanzi: 一人念，一人伸手数，两人对同一个字还有不同意思，正要进去找人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ràng kāimén , méi máng zhe tì tāmen jiědá , xiān qù gàosù chéng lù , zìjǐ nǎ yírì yǐhòu búzài lái jiē nà kuài jìlùbǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi moved from the doorway without rushing to explain to them, first telling Cheng Lu the day after which he'd no longer collect the recording board.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维让开门，没忙着替他们解答，先去告诉成路，自己哪一日以后不再来接那块记录板。
